name: AeolusLabs website

purpose.text: Finish a local Next.js company website for AeolusLabs, aimed at small and growing African businesses (Nigeria first), then launch it on aeoluslabsltd.com.

tasks.title: Fix the security lock: upgrade Next.js
tasks.purpose: Next.js 16.4.0 had critical remote-code-execution flaws; patched in 16.4.1+.

approval.basis: User said 'lets fix the lock' in chat on 2026-11-04 after the security finding was explained

acceptance_criteria.check: package.json pins a Next.js version >= 16.4.1
pnpm typecheck and pnpm build both exit 0
pnpm audit shows zero advisories for the next package
Built site's routes respond and the enquiry API still validates

tasks.title: Choose ONE style for the whole site
tasks.purpose: Homepage (navy/lime) and inner pages (older layout) do not match; minimalist prototypes are unapproved.

acceptance_criteria.check: Owner states which style wins (recorded in design-explorations.md and DESIGN.md)

tasks.title: Make the contact form really send email, with spam limits
tasks.purpose: Today the form only prepares a mailto draft; no rate limiting.

acceptance_criteria.check: Resend key and verified sender configured (secrets kept out of the repo)
A real test enquiry arrives at info@aeoluslabsltd.com
Repeated rapid submissions from one source are limited

tasks.title: Collect missing content from the owner
tasks.purpose: Real assets are needed; nothing may be invented.

acceptance_criteria.check: Real Vib3Pulse screenshots supplied and added
Founder portraits and short bios supplied and added
Social-sharing (OG) image added
Final logo supplied or current recreation confirmed
Written client permission recorded before any other client is published

tasks.title: Check Vib3Pulse feature claims
tasks.purpose: Account-only features (QR tickets, wallet, Safety Buddy, SOS) are unverified.

acceptance_criteria.check: Each listed feature is confirmed in the product or removed/softened on the site

tasks.title: Apply the chosen style to all pages
tasks.purpose: One consistent look across Home, Work, Solutions, Products, About, Contact, Privacy.

acceptance_criteria.check: Every route uses the chosen style
No horizontal overflow at 390/768/1440 widths
Keyboard navigation and visible focus work on every page

tasks.title: Fix page titles, theme colour and canonical address
tasks.purpose: Metadata still says 'Real problems. Thoughtful solutions', theme colours are white/black, and the live domain redirects to www.

acceptance_criteria.check: Titles and descriptions match the approved homepage message
Theme colour matches the site
Owner picks www or bare domain; metadataBase and sitemap match it

tasks.title: Tidy leftovers
tasks.purpose: Unused code and files, plus an unfixed text-encoding glitch.

acceptance_criteria.check: Unused components and public placeholder files removed
CLIENT-CASE-STUDIES-DRAFT.md saved as valid UTF-8
next-env.d.ts dev-only change not committed
Typecheck and build still pass after cleanup

tasks.title: Test it properly
tasks.purpose: No device, speed or accessibility testing has been recorded on the final site.

acceptance_criteria.check: Lighthouse run recorded for Home and one inner page
Checked on a real phone and a laptop
End-to-end enquiry test passes
Screen-reader/keyboard spot check recorded

tasks.title: Merge and go live
tasks.purpose: main still has the old homepage; domain currently shows an older site.

acceptance_criteria.check: Branch reviewed and merged to main
Vercel project and environment variables set
aeoluslabsltd.com serves the new site
Post-launch check of every page and the form

tasks.title: Optional: patch build-tool advisories
tasks.purpose: nanoid, browserslist and source-map-js advisories remain in build tooling (not served to visitors).

acceptance_criteria.check: pnpm overrides or updates applied, or risk accepted in writing

tasks.title: Fix empty grey tile on Solutions page
tasks.purpose: Seven services in a two-column grid leave one blank cell that shows as a grey block (seen in 2026-11-04 screenshot; cause: .feature-grid background shows through).

acceptance_criteria.check: No blank grey cell at 390, 768 and 1440 widths, whatever the service count

tasks.title: Phase 0: Baseline and documentation discovery
tasks.purpose: Measure current site and gather usable material before design work

approval.basis: Owner asked on 2026-11-04 to turn the experience upgrade plan into a track list worked one group at a time

acceptance_criteria.check: Baseline captures at 390/768/1440 in light and dark exist under architecture/evidence
Asset inventory lists approved project captures and missing founder assets
Baseline page transfer and image weight recorded with lab-vs-real-user distinction

tasks.title: Phase 1: Visual and motion foundation
tasks.purpose: One owner-reviewed visual and motion language for all later sections

approval.basis: Owner asked on 2026-11-04 to turn the experience upgrade plan into a track list worked one group at a time

acceptance_criteria.check: Editable homepage study and phone/desktop examples are reviewed by the owner
Motion contract with reduced-motion and responsive equivalents is documented
Shared controls pass keyboard and reduced-motion checks

tasks.title: Phase 2: Signature homepage opening
tasks.purpose: Make the first impression express Make room for better

approval.basis: Owner asked on 2026-11-04 to turn the experience upgrade plan into a track list worked one group at a time

acceptance_criteria.check: Opening reviewed in the real homepage with no layout jump or obstructed action
Phone and no-JS/reduced-motion states are usable
Offer and contact action are available immediately, with no forced intro

tasks.title: Phase 3: Real-work showcase and case-study story
tasks.purpose: Back the creative presentation with actual delivered software

approval.basis: Owner asked on 2026-11-04 to turn the experience upgrade plan into a track list worked one group at a time

acceptance_criteria.check: Project views switch reliably under rapid input with keyboard and focus support
Real images load correctly at 390/768/1440 from appropriately sized WebP assets
Narrative uses only supported claims and approved imagery

tasks.title: Phase 4: One useful Labs experiment
tasks.purpose: Let visitors experience original engineering craft directly

approval.basis: Owner asked on 2026-11-04 to turn the experience upgrade plan into a track list worked one group at a time

acceptance_criteria.check: One experiment chosen in an editable prototype and labelled as a studio experiment
Touch, keyboard, reset and reduced-motion behaviour work; no visitor data collected
Measured payload meets the agreed budget

tasks.title: Phase 5: Services, enquiry and studio presence
tasks.purpose: Turn interest into a relevant conversation and show the people behind the work

approval.basis: Owner asked on 2026-11-04 to turn the experience upgrade plan into a track list worked one group at a time

acceptance_criteria.check: Service-to-contact prefill passes direct-load, unknown-value and back-navigation cases without overwriting input
Form and assistant drafts stay intact through switching; delivery and fallback semantics preserved
About uses owner-supplied portraits with provenance, or the subtask is recorded as deferred

tasks.title: Phase 6: Integrated verification and release readiness
tasks.purpose: Keep the expressive site fast, accessible and dependable

approval.basis: Owner asked on 2026-11-04 to turn the experience upgrade plan into a track list worked one group at a time

acceptance_criteria.check: Integrated desktop/mobile/light/dark review and all-route keyboard/focus/reduced-motion tests have recorded evidence
Typecheck and production build pass; chat configuration verified without exposing keys
Performance compared with Phase 0 and exceptions recorded honestly

milestones.title: Safe and working
milestones.outcome: No known security holes in the site itself, and the contact form really delivers enquiries.

milestones.title: One look, real content
milestones.outcome: One agreed design on every page, with real screenshots, founder details and metadata.

milestones.title: Tested and live
milestones.outcome: Checked on real devices, merged to main and live on the owned domain.

milestones.title: Expressive, proven experience
milestones.outcome: Visitors meet a distinctive, credible studio story that leads to a relevant enquiry

discovery_notes.note: 2026-11-04: Whole-site minimal redesign built and browser-checked on branch codex/minimal-redesign (all routes, 390/768/1440, light and dark). Owner has not yet chosen between it and the navy branch (T-002 still open). T-006 would only be needed if the navy branch is chosen.

2026-11-04: Owner decided canonical address is www.aeoluslabsltd.com. Implemented on codex/minimal-redesign (metadataBase, sitemap, robots, titles, theme colour). Applies to T-007 on either branch; still to be applied on the navy branch if chosen.

2026-11-04: On codex/minimal-redesign the unused Tailwind/shadcn toolchain was removed; pnpm audit fell from 85 to 5 findings, all inside Next's own build tooling (partly addresses T-011). Solutions grey tile (T-012) and dead code (T-008) no longer exist on this branch. Navy branch still has all three.

2026-11-04: App icons added on codex/minimal-redesign: apple-icon.png 180 (opaque, iOS), icon.png/icon.svg/favicon.ico (tabs), manifest with 192, 512 and maskable 512 PNGs (Android), iOS home-screen title. Built from the supplied-reference logo recreation; swap in final brand artwork if supplied (T-004). Served files and head tags checked on a production build; not yet tested by installing on a real iPhone or Android phone (T-009). Old v0 placeholder images removed.

2026-11-04: T-003 wiring done on codex/minimal-redesign. Owner added RESEND_API_KEY in Vercel (Production only per screenshot). Code now needs only the key (sender defaults to enquiries@aeoluslabsltd.com, override with ENQUIRY_FROM_EMAIL); on missing key or Resend failure it returns a prepared mailto with an honest message and logs the cause; best-effort 5-per-15-min limit per IP per instance. Public DNS shows Resend DKIM and send-subdomain SPF/MX published and Google MX for info@. Tested locally: no key, invalid key (Resend 401 then fallback), rate limit (6th request 429), foreign origin 403, honeypot 400. NOT verified: a real email arriving in info@ (needs deploy + redeploy after env change), Resend dashboard shows domain Verified, Vercel Firewall rate-limit rule.

latest_handoff.summary: DESIGN.md is the single authority. Owner requested deletion of superseded briefs, forwarding files and archive copies; these are now removed. Runtime fixes remain open.
latest_handoff.next: Resolve the documented CSS and motion inconsistencies against DESIGN.md, then run the integrated verification gates.
latest_handoff.notes: Task results and prior evidence retained without promoting completion. Hosting observations date from 4 November and require rechecking.

authority_note: Execution/evidence ledger only. DESIGN.md owns current requirements and priorities. Older proposal wording and discovery notes are historical; do not infer new design direction from task status.
